nights.title: Giant Rooks
nights.name: Giant Rooks
nights.extract: Giant Rooks are a German indie rock band from Hamm, Germany founded in 2014. They are best known for their EP Wild Stare, their album How Have You Been? and their top-100 charting cover of "Tom's Diner" by Suzanne Vega.

nights.title: Joy Oladokun: The Heavy Things Tour
nights.name: Joy Oladokun
nights.extract: Olubukola Joy Oladokun is an American singer-songwriter. Oladokun's music spans the genres of folk, R&B, rock, and pop and is influenced by her identity as a queer person of color. She has released six studio albums: Carry (2016), In Defense of My Own Happiness  (2020), In Defense of My Own Happiness (2021), Proof of Life (2023), Observations from a Crowded Room (2024), and Hope is a Heavy Thing (2026).

nights.title: Zack Fox
nights.name: Zack Fox
nights.extract: Zachary Channing Fox is an American stand-up comedian, rapper, actor, DJ, and internet personality from Atlanta, Georgia. He has collaborated with Kenny Beats, Flying Lotus, Thundercat, Doechii, and Bnyx. He describes his genre of art as "Shemar-Core," a term that likely references actor Shemar Moore, who serves as an artistic muse for Fox.
